records.title: Stable Transformers for Graph Generation
records.reason: Graph Transformer stability for graph generation; outside language-model/VLM serving and inference optimization.

records.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
records.reason: The primary text studies how looped Transformers route different computations across recurrent steps using synthetic graph/parity/rule tasks, interventions, and small frozen per-token maps. It analyzes recurrent computation and steering rather than offering an inference-speed or memory reduction; deployment safety is not evaluated. Weak adjacency to looped-model lineage merits borderline.

records.title: LARC: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections for Learning in Frozen Models
records.reason: LARC adds a low-rank adaptive residual state to frozen models for learning from feedback. The primary technical report examines compact state and online adaptation, but its contribution is learning/adaptation rather than measured inference latency, throughput, KV memory, quantization, or serving. Retain as a weak compact-state relation only.

records.title: Fractional Laplace Neural Operators: Exact Architectures, an Expressivity Frontier at Criticality, and Certified Stability for Memory-Driven Network Dynamics
records.reason: Fractional neural operators for memory-driven network dynamics; mathematical architecture analysis outside LLM/VLM inference.
